summary.summary: Karpathy builds a small GPT-style language model in PyTorch. The walkthrough connects next-token prediction, causal self-attention, and text generation using Shakespeare data.

takeaways.text: Multiple attention heads provide additional communication channels and improve validation loss in this experiment.
Self-attention lets tokens exchange information; the feed-forward network then processes each token independently.
Residual connections add the previous features back after a transformation.
